source_locations.location: Main text, structural paragraph and Fig. 1
SI, Experimental Section, Synthesis of compound 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A wheel-shaped tetranuclear complex with an eight-membered La4Cl4 core and a 40-membered ring including the bis(amidinate) ligands. Each seven-coordinate La binds four amidinate nitrogen atoms, two bridging chlorides, and one THF molecule.

synthesis.procedure: The dipotassium dibenzofuran-linked bis(amidinate) ligand was reacted with excess LaCl3 in hot THF, affording compound 1 in moderate yield. The main article gives no numerical reagent quantity.
synthesis.temperature: hot THF; numerical temperature not reported
synthesis.time: 24 h reaction; crystals obtained after 5 h cooling
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The residue was dissolved in 15 mL toluene and heated. The warm solution was filtered and slowly cooled to room temperature, yielding yellow crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Dinuclear lanthanum dibenzofuran-linked bis(amidinate) amido complex

source_locations.location: Main text, paragraph accompanying Scheme 3 and Fig. S3 reference
SI, Experimental Section, Synthesis of compound 2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two dibenzofuran-linked bis(amidinate) ligands each bind both La atoms, forming a 20-membered metallacycle. Each La is five-coordinate, with amidinate donors and one bis(trimethylsilyl)amido group; the reported La–La separation is 7.6906(9) Å.

synthesis.procedure: The protonated dibenzofuran-linked bis(amidinate) ligand was reacted with La{N(SiMe3)2}3 in refluxing toluene by amine elimination. Compound 2 was recrystallized from toluene. No numerical preparative reagent quantity is given in the main article.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Recrystallized from toluene; the article notes that analytically pure bulk material could not be obtained.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Dinuclear samarium dibenzofuran-linked bis(amidinate) amido complex

source_locations.location: Main text, paragraph accompanying Scheme 3; Fig. 2
SI, Experimental Section, Synthesis of compound 3

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two dibenzofuran-linked bis(amidinate) ligands span the two Sm atoms to form a 20-membered metallacycle. Each Sm binds amidinate donors, a bis(trimethylsilyl)amido group, and THF; the reported Sm–Sm separation is 8.2441(11) Å.

synthesis.procedure: The protonated dibenzofuran-linked bis(amidinate) ligand was reacted with Sm{N(SiMe3)2}3 in refluxing toluene by amine elimination. Compound 3 was recrystallized from THF. No numerical preparative reagent quantity is given in the main article.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Mononuclear samarium phenanthrene-linked bis(amidinate) amido complex

source_locations.location: Main text, paragraph accompanying Scheme 4; Fig. 3
SI, Experimental Section, Synthesis of compound 4

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The phenanthrene-linked bis(amidinate) ligand coordinates asymmetrically to one Sm atom: one amidinate unit binds κ² through both nitrogen atoms, while the other binds κ¹. The five-coordinate metal also binds a bis(trimethylsilyl)amido group and THF.

synthesis.procedure: The protonated phenanthrene-linked bis(amidinate) ligand was reacted with a homoleptic samarium bis(trimethylsilyl)amide precursor at elevated temperature to give compound 4. The main article supplies no numerical preparative reagent quantity.
synthesis.temperature: elevated temperature; numerical temperature not reported
synthesis.time: 3 days reaction; crystals obtained after 5 h at room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Reaction with a homoleptic lanthanide amide
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The solvent was removed under vacuum, the yellow precipitate was washed with n-pentane and recrystallized from hot THF, yielding yellow single crystals.

title: Bis(amidinate) ligands in early lanthanide chemistry – synthesis, structures, and hydroamination catalysis
